findings.description: [defect] Hero headline (H1) wraps awkwardly in Japanese on both desktop (00-desktop-top.png) and mobile (02-mobile-top.png): on desktop the compound word "回帰" is split across lines ("テールレイテンシの回" / "帰を、") and "で。" is orphaned on a fourth line; on mobile both "を、" and "で。" appear as two-character orphan lines. Adjusting font size, column width, or phrase break points would avoid mid-word breaks and orphan particles.

[defect] In the Benchmark (ベンチマーク) horizontal bar chart (01-desktop-full.png), the dark-gray fill bars for "Docker Jaeger + ES" (4,800 ms) and "Cloud SaaS APM (下限)" (6,000+ ms) have very low contrast against the dark track and page background, weakening the immediate visual comparison against the amber "Kestrel Trace" bar.

[defect] On mobile (02-mobile-top.png), the three hero metrics ("18 MB", "0", "Docker") wrap into a 2+1 layout, leaving the right half of the second row empty and pushing the terminal preview almost completely below the fold.

[suggestion] In the Install (インストール) section (01-desktop-full.png), the two command blocks span roughly two-thirds of the container width and leave the right third empty, breaking the full-width right key line established by every other section on the page.

[suggestion] Inside the Differential Flamegraph chart container (01-desktop-full.png), there is noticeable unused vertical space between the third span row and the bottom "0 ms" / "234 ms (サンプル)" axis labels.

[suggestion] On mobile (02-mobile-top.png), the four desktop header navigation links ("デモ", "機能", "ベンチマーク", "プラン") are omitted with no visible menu toggle, leaving only the brand link and "インストール" CTA in the header.

verdict.summary: Approved within the reviewed scope (00-desktop-top.png, 01-desktop-full.png, 02-mobile-top.png). The Kestrel Trace landing page has a cohesive dark visual hierarchy, varied section layouts, crisp alignment across nearly all sections, clean table readability, and no overlap, clipping, or broken elements. Only minor polish issues were found: awkward Japanese orphan/mid-word wrapping in the hero H1 on desktop and mobile, low contrast on the two gray comparison bars in the benchmark chart, a 2+1 metric wrap on mobile, and minor right-side/vertical spacing polish in the install and flamegraph sections.
